positions.summary: Her targets have varied: the 2017 programme aimed at 3% of GDP by 2022, while the 2022 programme aimed at EUR 55bn by 2027 (about 2% of GDP). In 2026 the RN supports higher military budgets but stresses public-finance limits. No current commitment above 3% was found.

sources.outlet: M la France (Le Pen 2022 campaign site)
sources.quote: Porter le budget de la défense à 55 milliards d'euros à l'horizon 2027
augmenter le budget de la défense pour le porter à 2 % du PIB dès 2018 et à 3 % du PIB en 2022
Le Rassemblement national a soutenu la hausse du budget militaire

positions.nuance: No programme has ever gone above 3%: the 2017 target was exactly 3%, and the 2022 target was about 2%. In 2026 she says Ukraine aid must be cut for budget reasons, which suggests limits on defence spending too. The record is mixed; await the 2027 programme.
